  "reason": "Missing required field: cost_shortfall. The operator stated that the shortfall penalty has not been aligned with the market and should not be filled in yet. Allowed shortfall costs are [10.0, 20.0, 40.0] with cost_reserve=1.0. Please provide one of the allowed shortfall costs or confirm that the study should be rejected.",
